ITEM 1 | Scrambled eggs: soft pale-yellow clumps with a fluffy, curd-like texture and some small folds, spread over the right half of the plate, covering roughly 35% of the plate surface, about 2 cm tall at the thickest areas, moist with no visible browning | 150
ITEM 2 | Diced sweet-potato-like orange cubes: bright orange chunks about 1.5 to 2 cm square with slightly glossy, caramelized edges and some darker browned spots, clustered in the lower-left center of the plate and covering roughly 12% of the plate, about 1.5 cm tall, sitting next to the eggs | 80
ITEM 3 | Brown meat pieces: dark reddish-brown cubes about 1.5 to 2 cm with a seared, slightly glossy exterior and a dense texture, scattered among the orange cubes and one isolated piece near the top center of the plate, covering roughly 6% of the plate, about 1.5 cm tall | 45
ITEM 4 | Small dark item: a dark, almost black small piece about 1 cm across with a shriveled surface, sitting at the bottom edge of the orange cubes | 5
ITEM 5 | White creamy-looking dab: a small off-white, slightly glossy bit about 1 cm across tucked between the orange cubes and eggs, possibly a soft fat or sauce residue, with low height of about 0.5 cm | 5
